Background Information | Running | a | red | light | refers | to | the | behavior | of | motor | vehicles, | non | - | motor | vehicles, | and | pedestrians | crossing | the | stop | line | and | continuing | to | drive | in | violation | of | the | traffic | signal | light | instructions | when | the | red | light | is | on | and | prohibiting | passage | . | Regardless | of | the | reason, | violations | of | red | light | violations | will | be | punished | according | to | law | . | However, | the | video | equipment | at | the | intersection | is | also | very | cautious | every | time | it | collects | illegal | information | about | running | a | red | light | . | If | a | car | runs | a | red | light, | there | will | be | three | images | to | support | it | .

Background Information | In | addition | to | penalties | for | cars | running | red | lights, | there | are | also | penalties | for | pedestrians | running | red | lights | . | my | country's | road | traffic | safety | law | stipulates | that | pedestrians, | passengers, | and | non | - | motor | vehicle | drivers | who | violate | road | traffic | safety | laws | and | regulations | on | road | traffic | regulations | shall | be | given | a | warning | or | a | fine | of | not | less | than | five | yuan | but | not | more | than | fifty | yuan | .

Knowledge Introduction | Compared | with | life, | a | mere | 50 | yuan | fine | is | too | little, | so | among | the | current | punishments, | education | is | more | important, | such | as | voluntarily | assisting | the | traffic | police | to | stand | guard, | helping | to | persuade | others | not | to | run | red | lights, | and | so | on | .

Knowledge Introduction | In | order | to | make | pedestrians | more | consciously | abide | by | laws | and | regulations, | some | cities | have | begun | to | use | a | system | to | capture | pedestrians | running | red | lights | . | During | red | lights, | roadside | cameras | will | capture | the | faces | of | pedestrians | running | red | lights | and | simultaneously | expose | them | on | the | screen | . | At | the | same | time, | the | tweeter | at | the | intersection | reminds | "walk | the | zebra | crossing | and | don't | run | the | red | light" | at | intervals | .

Knowledge Introduction | When | a | pedestrian | runs | a | red | light | and | crosses | the | road, | the | camera | device | of | the | system | will | automatically | capture | the | face | of | the | person | . | No | matter | what | style | of | clothes | pedestrians | are | wearing, | whether | they | are | riding | bicycles | or | walking, | they | can | be | automatically | identified | . | The | system | uses | intelligent | monitoring, | analysis, | and | screening | to | capture | pedestrians | and | non | - | motor | vehicles | running | red | lights | under | red | light | conditions, | and | through | sound | prompts, | images | are | formed | to | be | simultaneously | exposed | on | the | TV | display | screen | and | scrolled | .

Knowledge Introduction | Running | a | red | light | is | not | only | an | uncivilized | traffic | behavior | but | also | endangers | the | safety | of | life | and | property | of | all | parties | on | the | road | . | We | must | develop | good | traffic | awareness | and | cross | roads | safely | and | respectfully | . | To | prevent | red | light | violations, | we | will | make | a | red | light | warning | device | , | which | will | alert | drivers | when | they | are | approaching | a | red | light | .

Further Reading | In | addition | to | "running | a | red | light", | in | fact, | you | can't | run | a | green | light | . | "Running | a | green | light" | refers | to | the | act | of | entering | an | intersection | when | traffic | is | heavy | even | though | the | signal | light | is | green, | which | may | cause | further | traffic | jams | . | Article | 53 | of | the | "Regulations | for | the | Implementation | of | the | Road | Traffic | Safety | Law | of | the | People's | Republic | of | China" | stipulates | : | "When | a | motor | vehicle | encounters | a | traffic | jam | at | an | intersection | ahead, | it | shall | stop | outside | the | intersection | and | wait | in | turn, | and | shall | not | enter | the | intersection | . | " | If | a | similar | situation | occurs, | a | fine | of | 100 | yuan | and | 2 | points | may | be | imposed | . | "Running | the | green | light" | can | also | be | called | "rushing | the | green | light" | . | The | so | - | called | "rushing | the | green | light" | means | that | if | there | is | a | traffic | jam | at | the | intersection | ahead | when | the | signal | light | turns | green, | you | should | wait | outside | the | intersection, | otherwise | it | will | be | regarded | as | a | green | light | . | the green  | light at this  | time
